name: Kosovo
headline: Kosovo: +3.6% growth in 2025, 3.9% inflation
sections: Kosovo is a $12.5 billion economy (2025), the world's 154th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.6% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $19K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 12.5% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 3.9% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 11.6% in 2022.
No recent data is available for this section.
The current account balance is −8.1% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 118% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 10.0% of GDP (2025).
Life expectancy is 78.2 years (2024). Population: 1.6 million (2025).
